description: Prompt for repairing the product code that blocks a ticket (ASS-390 AC2), on the host, before the ticket variation's VM is set up, in a clone of its own in a temporary folder (the grouped engines' Blocked, Repair Project): a project issue not on the latest master and not the ticket's own branch, fixed in a separate small merge request on change/<KEY>-fix-<n>, shown to work, pushed and opened through merge-request:create-fix — never the ticket's own branches, a credential, the Mac or the shared checkout; the ticket then waits on it. Not shown to work: nothing opened, what was tried for the operator. Logs what it found and changed in the change log (AC3); cites only what it read (AC7)

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the block: summary, root cause, failing check, evidence, its classification and the latest master's evidence
input-arguments.example: Seed script fails on a column master renamed

fixed.description: true when the fix was shown to work and its merge request opened through merge-request:create-fix

fix-merge-request.description: Fixed only: the fix merge request's url, as merge-request:create-fix printed it; left out otherwise

evidence.description: The commands run and what each showed

ai-feedback-short.description: Fixed: the merge request and what it fixes; else what the operator must do — one line, shown on the dashboard

ai-feedback-long.description: What was found, what was tried or done, and what must be done
